text: Imagine paying twelve thousand dollars for a luxury festival and getting a cheese sandwich.
Billy McFarland pitched investors a ninety million dollar company. It had done about sixty thousand in business.
Guests got tents. And this sandwich.
He pleaded guilty to wire fraud. Then, out on bail, he sold fake tickets to events like the Met Gala.
Would you go to Fyre Festival Two? Yes or no, comment.
